t: The Verve VGG130 Gardening Gloves in green provide high-durability hand protection for general maintenance and outdoor work. These medium unisex gloves are ideal for landscapers and gardeners tackling heavy duty tasks like digging, clearing brambles, and pruning thorny plants. Tough leather palms with anti-slip padding offer a secure grip on tools, while integrated touchscreen fingertips allow phone usage without glove removal. Fully adjustable Velcro cuffs ensure a snug fit that keeps dirt and debris out, and the breathable fabric blend delivers reliable comfort during long shifts.
